title: Home symlinks can misroute outpost repositories
detail: With garden_v2_enabled, a home path that is a symlink to a different repository can change the bed selected for an outpost checkout at the same path. An isolated outpost bridge probe planted a seed from shop and read it back in billing's bed; a second reviewer independently reproduced the same behavior. The matcher resolves the outpost path against the home's filesystem. Root delegation reaches the same matcher by source trace. See s-mnw09n and s-engvyg.
